verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities/upsert accepts non-JSON string values for JSON-type fields without validation. Source code (utils.go:760-761) shows JSON fields bypass all type checking that other field types receive. Contract defines JSON as a distinct data type implying JSON object/array values, not arbitrary strings. This matches historical REST v2 data type handling issues (bug_shapes rest-v2-data-type-handling, 26 instances) and developer_cognition blindspot for REST v2 serialization. Reproducible: upsert with meta='invalid_json_string' → HTTP 200 success, no error.
